package audit

import (
	"context"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	rules "example.test/auditapp/internal/rules/audit"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/auditapp/internal/storage/queries/audit"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgtype"
	"github.com/plutoframework/pluto-core/pagination"
)

// EventStore is the authored audit adapter. It reaches the database only
// through scope.DB transactions bound to the verified tenant.
type EventStore struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewEventStore(db scope.DB) *EventStore { return &EventStore{db: db} }

func (s *EventStore) Append(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.NewEvent,
) error {
	return s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		return s.AppendTx(ctx, tx, in)
	})
}

// AppendTx joins a caller's transaction, so the event commits or rolls back
// with the business change. The actor and tenant come from the transaction.
func (s *EventStore) AppendTx(
	ctx context.Context,
	tx scope.Tx,
	in models.NewEvent,
) error {
	_, err := queriesOf(tx).AppendEvent(
		ctx,
		queries.AppendEventParams{
			OrgID:   tx.Tenant(),
			ActorID: tx.SubjectID(),
			Type:    in.Type,
			Payload: []byte(in.Payload),
			Hash:    rules.EventHash(in.Type, in.Payload),
		},
	)

	return err
}

func (s *EventStore) Query(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.ListRequest,
) (pagination.Page[models.Entry], error) {
	var page pagination.Page[models.Entry]

	after, err := afterSeq(in.Page)
	if err != nil {
		return page, err
	}

	err = s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		rows, err := queriesOf(tx).ListEvents(
			ctx,
			queries.ListEventsParams{
				OrgID:     tx.Tenant(),
				After:     after,
				ActorID:   in.ActorID,
				EventType: in.Type,
				Since:     timestamp(in.From),
				Until:     timestamp(in.To),
				MaxRows:   int32(in.Page.FetchLimit()),
			},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		entries := make([]models.Entry, 0, len(rows))
		for _, row := range rows {
			entries = append(entries, models.Entry{
				Seq:       row.Seq,
				Type:      row.Type,
				Payload:   row.Payload,
				Hash:      row.Hash,
				CreatedAt: row.CreatedAt.Time.UTC(),
			})
		}

		page, err = pagination.Finish(in.Page, entries, entryKey)

		return err
	})

	return page, err
}

func (s *EventStore) Scan(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	after, limit int64,
) ([]models.Entry, error) {
	var entries []models.Entry

	err := s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		rows, err := queriesOf(tx).ScanEvents(
			ctx,
			queries.ScanEventsParams{
				OrgID:   tx.Tenant(),
				After:   after,
				MaxRows: int32(limit),
			},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		for _, row := range rows {
			entries = append(entries, models.Entry{
				Seq:       row.Seq,
				Type:      row.Type,
				Payload:   row.Payload,
				Hash:      row.Hash,
				CreatedAt: row.CreatedAt.Time.UTC(),
			})
		}

		return nil
	})

	return entries, err
}

func entryKey(entry models.Entry) pagination.Key {
	return pagination.Key{ID: strconv.FormatInt(entry.Seq, 10)}
}

func afterSeq(request pagination.Request) (int64, error) {
	if request.After.ID == "" {
		return 0, nil
	}

	return strconv.ParseInt(request.After.ID, 10, 64)
}

func timestamp(value time.Time) pgtype.Timestamptz {
	return pgtype.Timestamptz{Time: value, Valid: !value.IsZero()}
}
